periods.time: vol-15 ch-004, climax of the rose-garden duel

name.zh: 多多良以星之锤摧毁艾茵
name.en: Yui destroys Ein with Astral Force

periods.type: self-destructive finishing move / representative duel resolution
periods.summary: Yui burns her body with Angel Dust, reaches the World Tree root, and detonates Astral Force to annihilate Ein and the castle at the cost of catastrophic injuries.
periods.cause: Ein's Netherworld World Tree makes ordinary reflection and Damage Reflect ineffective; Yui needs a force external to Ein large enough to uproot the massive body.
periods.process: Yui remembers Ein's old lessons about avoiding waste and completing work with no remaining reserves. She takes the House of Darkness stimulant Angel Dust, massively raising concentration at the cost of brain and body damage. She reflects the tulips' echolocation sound so their bullets miss, uses Total Reflect only to slightly alter lethal bamboo trajectories, and sacrifices limbs, side, ear and sight to cross the last meters. Reaching the root, she thanks the old Ein and pulls her chainsaw Device beyond its limit. Astral Force redirects a fragment of the planet's orbital force into the target, producing a white explosion like a small nuclear blast.
periods.outcome: The castle and Netherworld World Tree are erased, and Ein is apparently killed. Yui is thrown to the crater edge, deafened, mutilated and near death.
periods.aftermath: Yui thinks she has achieved a proper killer's end, but remembers Stella's promise to hold a loud Vermillion state funeral for her; annoyed and secretly touched, she wills herself not to die and mentally asks Ikki not to let Stella die.
casualties: yui-tatara critically wounded and likely disabled without medical aid
periods.significance: Turns Yui and Ein's duel into a mutual-destruction victory for Vermillion, reveals Astral Force's planetary-scale principle, and creates urgent need for medical support.
